scope: Public-data and provenance recheck for the California State University Los Angeles Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility (HRFF)

sources.title: Multi-year energy performance data for an electrolysis-based hydrogen refueling station

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The open article reports real station records and aggregate KPIs, but the public article and indexed records expose no downloadable synchronized station-to-vehicle logger, channel dictionary or reuse terms for the underlying rows.

sources.title: Hydrogen station in situ back-to-back fueling data for design and modeling

reported_scope.period: one year of Cal State LA HRFF operation
reported_scope.event_data: vehicle fueling reports and dynamic refueling trends
reported_scope.sampling_statement: the accepted manuscript states that process parameters were recorded every second
reported_dynamic_fields: tank, hose and blowdown valve states

public_artifact_inspection.finding: The accepted manuscript documents a high-value one-second station/vehicle data schema and real back-to-back operation, but the OSTI record supplies the manuscript only. No public CSV/XLSX/SQL export, channel dictionary, calibration package or reuse permission for raw traces was found.

sources.title: Hydrogen Station Data Collection and Analysis / Cal State LA HRFF
sources.reported_scope: The facility used SQL-backed data acquisition and generated station performance reports for DOE/NREL; the public materials describe the data program but do not publish the underlying logger export.

queries: Cal State LA Hydrogen Research and Fueling Facility csv
Hydrogen station back-to-back fueling data download
public_search.finding: No public synchronized station-to-vehicle raw export meeting the frozen eligibility rule was located. The two Cal State LA articles are high-value real-world provenance and data-request leads, not independently scorable holdouts.

recommended_next_step.action: Send the prepared Cal State LA request only after the project owner supplies name, affiliation and institutional contact.
minimum_request: de-identified CSV/XLSX export with common timestamps
instantaneous flow or cumulative delivered mass
storage, compressor, chiller and valve states
initial conditions, tank capacity and protocol version
quality/calibration metadata and written reuse terms
recommended_next_step.freeze_rule: Hash and quarantine any received files; freeze the model commit, inclusion criteria and scoring before reading numerical outcomes.

claim_boundary: The Cal State LA material proves access to credible real-station provenance and a detailed event-level schema, but it does not by itself validate this digital twin. Do not claim IJHE-level independent full-loop validation until a raw synchronized holdout and reuse terms are obtained and the frozen protocol passes.
